reviews.title: Highly recommend.
reviews.comment: This cooler does a solid job overall. Temps dropped noticeably compared to the stock cooler, and it runs pretty quietly even under load. The aRGB lighting looks clean without being over the top, and installation was straightforward. My only gripe is that the water lines are not quite as long as expected, though this is mostly a build problem with my case. For the price, it’s a dependable liquid cooler that performs well and looks good doing it.  The fans seem nice and wuiet as well.  I think it will last longer than my older cooler.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: The cooler is great, the included thermal paste isn't.
reviews.comment: I'm very happy with the performance and looks of the cooler. It easily mounts to your motherboard (AM4 in my case) and the radiator mounted to the top of my Lian-Li LANCOOL 207 DIGITAL case using the case rails. The only thing I wasn't impressed with was the included thermal paste. The paste is more like thick putty, far thicker than other thermal pastes I've used in the past. Being so thick, I didn't want to just place a blob in the center or even a X of paste on the CPU, so spreading was the only option. I will use something else if I have to re-paste in the future.
